terminals.name: vite-dev
terminals.description: Vite dev server on http://localhost:5173. The Panchanga/Kundali backend lives in a separate repo (patro, FastAPI), so this points VITE_API_BASE_URL at the live API. To develop against a local backend instead, drop VITE_API_BASE_URL and run `npm run dev` (vite.config.ts proxies /api to http://localhost:8080).
